title: GUITester: Enabling GUI Agents for Exploratory Defect Discovery

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating MLLM-powered GUI agents on an interactive benchmark (GUITestBench) to measure their tendency to misidentify genuine software defects as their own operational errors or execution imprecision.

Observing execution trajectories to determine if agents inherently prioritize task completion by bypassing functional anomalies and seeking alternative paths rather than verifying states and reporting the defects.
